requirements_text:
- Previous experience in working within a construction related environment; Knowledge of geotechnical processes.
- Excellent AutoCAD skills. Good IT skills - Knowledge of Microsoft Office packages (Excel, Word, Outlook, …), _Knowledge of VBA and Macros would be an advantage
- Experience in processing raw survey data and producing reports based on pile testing data. _Experience in GPR and FerroScan data processing would be an advantage.
- Ability to communicate clearly with a wide range of people.
- Excellent attention to detail to produce accurate work and ability to check drawings/models put together by the site team.
- Good use of your initiative; Self-motivated and enthusiastic and able to work as part of a team.
- Excellent time management skills with an emphasis on delivery and meeting delivery schedules.
